effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] Trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) (Rule) Trait: Has [Ice-Snow] Type.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] If this Digimon has the [Ice-Snow] trait, you may change the attack target to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the fewest digivolution cards.
